title: Retain and retrieve activity-specific change context
description: Maintains and assembles a current structured handoff for an active Change so another authorized participant can decide what to do next without conversation history.
inputs: Change identity and supported activity: authoring, implementation, verification, or review.
Recorded scope, state, responsible participants, findings or blockers, next action, and authoritative activity-specific references and basis revisions.
preconditions: The Change is within the declared governed scope and the recording or retrieving participant is authorized for the requested context.
outputs: Retrievable common and activity-specific resumption context with its authoritative references.
Explicit missing, conflicting, stale, or inapplicable context and the next recorded action without an implied authority grant.
behavior: Assemble goal/scope/authority, governing basis, progress, open issues and rationale, relevant evidence, review standing and next action from their single authoritative owners.
Accept explicit updates at meaningful handoffs and material decision changes; no record per edit, local command or intermediate test run is required.
Replace superseded working summaries where comparable; retain unresolved issues until explicit disposition and enough assessed basis for current judgments.
Distinguish reported applicability from mechanical observations, planned checks from results and missing data from approval or no work.
Return gaps, responsible owners and authority limits without inventing the next action or review judgment.
For completion return the compact historical outcome; do not monitor it against current repository files. Later regression belongs to linked new work.
Restored or unavailable operational state has explicit scope and limitations; neither renews support or authority.

failure_behavior.condition: Required context is missing, conflicting, stale, or inaccessible.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the known context with explicit gaps and the recorded responsible participant or decision needed; do not invent a next action or result.

failure_behavior.condition: A suggested next action lacks applicable authorization.
failure_behavior.outcome: Keep the suggestion distinguishable from authority and identify the unmet boundary before execution.

sources.basis: Existing SR-006 confirms this activity-specific resumption behavior under IR-003. Its full recorded activity coverage and acceptance criteria remain unchanged.

Propose MOD-006 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.
User-selected current handoff and selective retention refinement. Reuse existing identity and responsibility; no runtime adoption or independent approval is asserted.
